verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents headless automation through its GraphQL API and GitHub Actions. The API docs show querying project items, adding issues, PRs and draft issues, and updating field values. Authentication can use a GitHub App installation token, which suits non-interactive CI runs. missing for 10: concrete GitHub Actions workflow examples for projects, evidence that the official CLI covers project operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can also use the GraphQL API and GitHub Actions to take even greater control of your project.
You can query the API to find information about items in your project.
The following example will add an issue or pull request to your project.
The following example will update the value of a single select field for an item.
The token can be a personal access token (classic) for a user or an installation access token for a GitHub App.
